senses.gloss: c. (b. h.; prob. fr. <he>עקב</he>, with anorg. <cite ref="T00000"><he>ר</he></cite>; cmp. <cite ref="P01447"><he>עַרְקוֹב</he></cite>)

units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:5">Ab. V, 5</cite> <he>ולא הזיק נחש וע׳ וכ׳</he> nor did ever a serpent or a scorpion harm anybody in Jerusalem.
<cite ref="Shabbat 121b:4">Sabb. 121ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ שבחדייב</he> the scorpion of Adiabene; Y. ib. XIV, beg. 14ᵇ.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:8">Num. R. s. 10</cite> <he>היין משול בע׳</he> (some ed. <he>כע׳</he>) wine is compared to a scorpion; <he>מה ע׳ מכה בעוקצו … סופו</he> as the scorpion wounds with its tail, so wine wounds at the end. Sifra K’dosh., Par. 1, ch. II <he>עקצתו ע׳</he> if a scorpion stung him; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="P01222"><he>עַקְרַבִּים</he></cite>, <cite ref="P01222"><he>עַקְרַבִּין</he></cite>. Sabb. l. c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:16">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 37:24">Gen. XXXVII, 24</cite>) <he>מים אין בו אבל נחשים וע׳ וכ׳</he> water was not, but serpents and scorpion were therein; a. fr.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 20:1">Pesik. R. s. 20</cite>. Num. R. l. c. <he>כל שעה … אין ע׳ וכ׳</he> as long as Kimah (v. <cite ref="K00560"><he>כִּימָה</he></cite>) is visible, Scorpio is invisible; a. fr.

senses.gloss: עַקְרַב בית הבד the iron-shod part of the pressbeam. Ib. XII, 3.
